I told Dana in a reply to their #north-team message that the settled figure is **261 seats**. Ilse posted that number in the channel on Oct 14.

- **Who can see it:** Dana is a member of #north-team, so they can already see Ilse's message. A seat count is an account fact, not a money figure, so it can go to the account team.
- **What I checked:** I found no other seat count in the channel or in the North team's shared notes, including the cheat sheet and the March renewal check-in.
- **Not checked against the contract:** none of the shared folders I can read have a Quarrendon contract file. I told Dana that June or Ilse would have the signed copy if the tracker needs that confirmation.

My summary from the last request was also posted as its own message in #north-team. It only repeats the 261 figure, which was already in the channel, so nothing private got out.
